title: Nanoscience with Attosecond Laser Pulses
abstract: In this paper the interaction of attosecond laser pulses with matter is investigated. The scattering and potential motion of heat carriers as well as the external force are considered. Depending on the ratio of the scatterings and potential motion the heat transport is described by the thermal forced Klein-Gordon or thermal modified telegraph equation. For thermal Heisenberg type relation V tau=hbar (tau is the relaxation time and V is the potential) the heat transport is described by the thermal distortionless damped wave equation. In this paper Klein-Gordon modified telegraph equation and wave equation are solved. Key words: Attosecond laser pulses; Quantum heat transport equation; Klein-Gordon thermal equation.
